5689.title: Expired Codex credentials bypass AI readiness checks
5689.rootCauseOneLine: The credential reader accepts expired OAuth tokens and the readiness handler equates a successful read with availability.
5689.proposedFix: Reject known-expired credentials with host-specific recovery or coordinate refresh through the credential owner; authentication changes are outside the autopilot simple-fix gate.
5689.caveats: Two clean host-harness reproductions with synthetic credentials and intercepted HTTP; real OAuth refresh and end-to-end UI/CLI/title/commit flows are untested. The complete test is inline; raw artifacts stay local under reports publication policy.
